subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: Should Codex message-tool-only completion require explicit `final=true`, or preserve implicit terminal delivery and use prompt-only steering?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100156 fix the same confirmed bug but establish mutually exclusive durable behavior for otherwise valid message-tool sends.

options.title: Explicit final contract
options.body: Make progress sends non-terminal and require `final=true` for completed current-source replies, scoped exclusively to Codex message-tool-only.

options.title: Prompt-only steering
options.body: Keep every delivered current-source send terminal and rely on instructions to prevent progress sends.

recommendation.title: Explicit final contract
recommendation.body: Make progress sends non-terminal and require `final=true` for completed current-source replies, scoped exclusively to Codex message-tool-only.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged source-reply completion change introduced the terminal recognition being refined.
